name: The Expanse: Adramelech Exodus
source:
Fan game set in the Expanse universe. Months after the sixth book, a Ring Gate is covered in a mysterious biological layer. The protagonists must venture beyond to uncover what lies within.

[From [url=https://jameshillten.itch.io/the-expanse-adramelech-exodus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
粉丝游戏以Expanse宇宙为背景。第六本书出版几个月后，环门被神秘的生物层覆盖。主角们必须冒险超越，揭开其中的真相。

[来自[url=https://jameshillten.itch.io/the-expanse-adramelech-exodus]Itch.io[/url]]
